user.title: Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open [this login page]({login_url}) in a desktop browser.
2. Before logging in, open the developer tools (F12) and select the Network tab.
3. Log in with your AH account. The browser then tries to open `appie://login-exit?code=...`; that fails, which is expected.
4. In the Network tab, find the request containing `login-exit` (or the `Location` header of the last redirect) and copy the full URL or just the `code` value.
5. Paste it below. The code expires quickly.
